messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians can enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one adjacent Saturday or Sunday.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 | Mon | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Mon) |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 | Mon | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| 5 | Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 | Mon | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Mon | **Nov 9–11** (Sat–Mon) |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

> **Quick notes**  
> * **New Year’s Day** falls on a Sunday, so the holiday is observed on Monday, Jan 2.  
> * **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday, so the holiday is observed on Monday, Jul 3.  
> * **Good Friday** is a statutory holiday that automatically creates a long weekend (Friday to Sunday).  
> * All other holidays listed above fall on a Monday, giving you a Saturday‑to‑Monday break.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. Jean‑Baptiste in Québec, etc.), let me know and I can add those too.
